text:
nina: Repro help wanted: sample App shows duplicate POSTs and stalled streaming when a token refresh happens mid-stream on some Pixel/emulator images. Repro steps: start long /v1/generate stream -> trigger login switch -> observe doubled requests in backend and occasional stuck client.

leo: what okhttp + retrofit versions? also how are you wiring coroutine cancellation to call.cancel()?

nina: Retrofit 2.9 + OkHttp 4.10.0. We're using suspend functions with `call.awaitResponse()` wrapper. On cancellation we call call.cancel() from the coroutine finally block. Logs show okhttp issuing a second POST (same body) without Authorization header then 401 then a third with header.

rachel: Could be body isn't repeatable (streaming), but you said duplicate POSTs same body? check request.body() instanceof ReplayRequestBody?

nina: body is chunked streaming from a local generator -> not replayable. But server sees two POSTs with identical body length and checksum; suspicious.

leo: maybe the auth-refresh path triggers a synchronous retry on connection failure which resends the request without updated header. There's an OkHttp bug where request headers can be lost on connection retry in some TLS resumption cases (fixed in 4.11.x).

nina: interesting. Any immediate workaround we can ship in sample app while we upgrade?

tom: quick options: 1) make the refresh request use a separate OkHttp client (no interceptors) so it doesn't interfere, 2) mark refresh requests with `X-Refresh-Request: 1` and skip retry logic for them, 3) set `client.retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` for streaming endpoints.

rachel: also ensure your Authenticator checks for the header so you don't try to refresh a refresh request. e.g., `if (request.header("X-Refresh-Request") != null) return null` in authenticate().

leo: another pattern: centralize refresh with a single in-flight Deferred/CompletableFuture. When an auth failure happens, other callers await the same refresh result instead of invoking another refresh. Prevents 429s on token endpoint.

nina: we already dedupe refreshes but the issue persists even with a single refresh because the retry I'm seeing happens before the new header is attached to the retried call. Might be a race between updating tokenProvider and OkHttp retry.

tom: For the sample app I pushed a small local workaround: set `callTimeout` to a slightly higher value and mark the streaming endpoint client `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` plus use a fresh OkHttp client for token refresh. This reduced dupes in emulator tests.

ci-bot: CI flaky test detected: sample-app/android-emulator-api-33 network flake. See https://ci.internal/1234/logs

leo: plan: upgrade OkHttp to 4.11.1 in sample app, add note in devex doc about `Authenticator` + single inflight refresh + upgrade. If that doesn't completely fix, keep the `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` for streaming routes.

nina: thanks, I'll open PR `devex/fix-streaming-auth-2012345678` with the upgrade + workaround and add detailed repro steps in the PR description. Will follow up with CI results.
